claims.label: Epstein Email Asserts Rothschild Representation
claims.claim: A Jeffrey Epstein email to Peter Thiel, recently released, states that Epstein represents the Rothschilds.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain full Epstein-to-Thiel email metadata and surrounding thread to verify context, date, and any operational substance.

claims.label: Erika Kirk 2017 Instagram Post Thanks "Uncle Allan" Rothstein
claims.claim: In a 2017 Instagram post the host reads, Erika Kirk addresses "Uncle Allan" as someone filled with spirit who has shown courage through adversity; the host identifies him as Alan Rothstein, whom she says chaired Win Haven Real Estates.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm the post via Instagram archives or third-party captures; verify Alan Rothstein's role at Win Haven Real Estate through corporate filings.

claims.label: Erika Kirk Real-Estate Bio Asserts Fiduciary Real-Estate Practice in NYC
claims.claim: Erika Kirk's published real-estate bio describes her as a "multi-dimensional entrepreneur" whose NYC real-estate practice focuses on the "fiduciary relationship" with clients, alongside claims of prior work as an agency-represented model, actress, and casting director.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate original bio on archived real-estate listings or brokerage websites; cross-reference fiduciary claim against any documented transactions.

claims.label: Host Says She Found Relic of Erika Kirk's NY Real-Estate License
claims.claim: The host says she found, on a third-party site, a relic record of a New York real-estate license attributed to Erika Kirk (License #10401322765), which she infers was issued October 24, 2018, and valid at least until 2020.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify license against NY Department of State public licensee search before October 2026 record-retention cutoff; obtain any associated transaction records.

claims.label: Host asks New York real-estate professionals for tips confirming Erika's license and sales
claims.claim: The host asks New York real-estate professionals to report what they can find, to confirm Erika's real-estate license and what she sold, and to send tips to candaceowens.com.
claims.investigative_direction: Log tips received through candaceowens.com against the NY Department of State licensee search; route any verified sales records to N-10526.
claims.transcript_snippet: If you can confirm Erika's real estate license and what she sold.

claims.label: Erika Kirk American Race Audition Tape Describes Opening Romanian Orphanage with Marines
claims.claim: In her audition tape for "The American Race," Erika Kirk stated she had traveled to Romania and "teamed up with the Marine Corps to open up and sustain an orphanage with 75 beautiful children" called "Romanian Angels" through her nonprofit "Everyday Heroes Like You."
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the full audition tape for timestamp and surrounding context; verify the orphanage claim against Marine Corps records and Romanian government records.

claims.label: Larissa Email Describes Antonio Placement Center as Corrupt and Erika-Linked
claims.claim: An email from "Larissa," a former Antonio Placement Center resident adopted internationally, states that the center is "notorious for corruption and illicit activities such as trafficking children," that Larissa herself was placed there under dubious circumstances, and that Erika Kirk's promotional materials from approximately 2012 to 2014 specifically referenced the Antonio Placement Center as a partner for international efforts.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify Larissa's identity and adoption record; locate Erika Kirk's 2012–2014 promotional materials referencing Antonio Placement Center; obtain Romanian government or NGO documentation of center's operational history.

claims.label: Tyler Bowyer Social-Media Statement Attributes Romania 2010 Trip to Academic Study
claims.claim: In a social-media exchange, Tyler Bowyer stated he studied Romanian in college to complement Russian studies and did a few weeks studying abroad in school.
claims.investigative_direction: Capture the full social-media exchange for context; verify Bowyer's claimed academic program at ASU; cross-reference against the 2010 Romanian consulate / lectorate timeline.

claims.label: Per Host, SB 1439 Proposes Charlie Kirk Memorial Specialty License Plate with Grassroots-Network Fund
claims.claim: Per Arizona SB 1439 as the host presents it, the bill proposed a "Charlie Kirk Memorial Plate" specialty license plate featuring Charlie Kirk's photo and the Turning Point USA logo on an American flag background, with $17 of the fee deposited annually into a "conservative grassroots network special plate fund."
claims.investigative_direction: Retrieve full SB 1439 text from Arizona Legislature archives; identify statutory fund recipient and allocation mechanism.

claims.label: Katie Hobbs Veto Letter Rejects SB 1439 as Inserting Politics into Non-Partisan Function
claims.claim: Governor Katie Hobbs vetoed SB 1439, stating in her veto letter that Charlie Kirk's assassination was tragic, that political violence is harmful to democratic institutions, and that the bill "falls short" by "inserting politics into a function of government that should remain non-partisan."
claims.investigative_direction: Retrieve full veto letter and accompanying Arizona legislative record; identify any subsequent legislation reintroducing the plate.

claims.label: Jake Hoffman Fox News Appearance Denounces Veto as Partisan
claims.claim: On Fox News, Arizona State Senator Jake Hoffman stated that the SB 1439 veto reflects Katie Hobbs's "nakedly partisan" record, that Hobbs vetoed about nine of his bills the previous year, and that the Charlie Kirk plate would honor a "civil rights leader of our time."
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain full Fox News clip with date; verify Hoffman's claimed chairmanship of the Arizona Nominations Committee and prior vetoes cited.

claims.label: Tyler Bowyer X Post Condemns SB 1439 Veto
claims.claim: Tyler Bowyer posted on X: "Every nonprofit in Arizona that has major roots has a license plate. Katie Hobbs vetoed this uh over politics after Charlie was brutally murdered. Disgusting."
claims.investigative_direction: Capture original X post URL and timestamp; verify whether post remains live or has been edited/deleted.

claims.label: Host Says Super Feed Inc. Is Copyright Holder of Turning Point USA App
claims.claim: The host says the fine print on the Turning Point USA mobile application lists Super Feed Inc. as the copyright holder, which she says means that is where users' data is going.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain current app-store listing and EULA for Super Feed Inc.; cross-reference Super Feed's corporate filings and any Erika Kirk / Tyler Bowyer / Lori Frantzve board or officer roles.

claims.label: Arizona Announced as First US State to Open Trade Office in Romania
claims.claim: A headline announcement (per host) states Arizona to be the first US state to open a trade office in Romania, with the announcement occurring in July of the prior year.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate original announcement source and date; identify Arizona-Romania trade office structure, funding, and personnel.

claims.label: Host Rejects Specific Erika Kirk Bio Credentials as Unverifiable
claims.claim: The host asserts that Erika Kirk's real-estate bio claims of "magna cum laude" graduation and a double major in political science and international relations at Arizona State University cannot be confirmed, and that international relations was not offered as a major in her claimed graduation year.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain Erika Kirk's official ASU transcript via FERPA request (with consent) or court subpoena; verify degree conferral and honors designation.

claims.label: Host Reports Inability to Verify NY Real-Estate License Through State Records
claims.claim: The host asserts she was unable to independently verify Erika Kirk's NY real-estate license on the New York State Division of Licenses website, finding only a relic on a third-party site, and says that from what she sees at first glance the state is supposed to hold this information for at least six years.
claims.investigative_direction: Conduct direct NY Department of State licensee search before October 2026 retention cutoff; capture screenshot evidence for archive.

claims.label: SB 1439 Recipient Description Matches Turning Point USA Characteristics
claims.claim: Per host reading of SB 1439, the bill's "conservative grassroots network special plate fund" description – a nonprofit founded in 2012 focusing on restoring traditional values, maintaining a grassroots activist network on high school and college campuses in Arizona, and assisting with voter registration and absentee ballots – matches characteristics of Turning Point USA, although TPUSA is not named explicitly in the bill.
claims.investigative_direction: Retrieve full bill text; cross-reference fund descriptors against Turning Point USA's founding date, mission, and Arizona activities.

claims.label: Host did not seek Erika's comment on this episode's follow-up
claims.claim: The host says her team did not send Erika Kirk a request for comment on this episode because Erika ignored the first email question, so a related follow-up was not expected to be answered.
claims.investigative_direction: Retain the first Next Model inquiry email and any reply or non-reply record to show the comment history.
claims.transcript_snippet: we did not go out to Erika for comment regarding today's episode because it makes very little sense if someone ignores your first email question

claims.label: Epstein frequented Next Model Management's offices
claims.claim: The host says Jeffrey Epstein was around Next Model Management's office a lot and frequented it as one would an office of friends, and calls this a fact.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain named eyewitnesses or visitor and email records placing Epstein at Next's offices and on what dates.
claims.transcript_snippet: Jeffrey Epstein was around this office a lot. He frequented the office as you would if it was your friends. All of this is a fact.

claims.label: Faith Kates known for launching Eastern European models
claims.claim: The host says Faith Kates is known for having made the careers of various Eastern European models and that Next's offices had many Eastern European models passing through.
claims.investigative_direction: Check agency press and model-biography records for Kates's Eastern European signings and dates.
claims.transcript_snippet: She's actually known for having made the careers of various Eastern European models.

claims.label: Faith Kates was Wilhelmina VP before co-founding Next
claims.claim: The host says Faith Kates knew Epstein before she co-founded Next because she was previously vice president of the women's division at Wilhelmina Models, which the host says Fran (Francis) Rothschild co-founded.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify Kates's Wilhelmina title and dates and the Wilhelmina founding record; test the host's claim that she knew Epstein in that period.
claims.transcript_snippet: she was actually the vice president of the women's division over at Wilhelmina Models first.

claims.label: Host says Zionist donors were squeezing Charlie before his death
claims.claim: The host says Zionists were pressuring, morally blackmailing and stressing Charlie Kirk at the end of his life and pulling money away from him and the organization.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the donors, dates and amounts withdrawn from TPUSA in 2025 through donor records, filings or named sources.
claims.transcript_snippet: Zionists were also the people that were squeezing Charlie Kirk at the end of his life.

claims.label: Host says Charlie said he was done with the pro-Israel cause
claims.claim: The host says Charlie Kirk himself said he was done with the pro-Israel cause.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the recorded or written statements, or witnesses, to Kirk saying he was finished with the pro-Israel cause, with dates.
claims.transcript_snippet: Charlie himself said that he was done with the pro-Israel cause.

claims.label: Erika appeared before Ben Shapiro at AmFest
claims.claim: The host says that after the murder Erika Kirk reversed course and, at AmFest, Erika came out first and Ben Shapiro came out second, even though the host says Shapiro was an enemy to Charlie.
claims.investigative_direction: Check the AmFest 2025 program and stage footage for speaker order and Shapiro's appearance.
claims.transcript_snippet: Immediately, Ben Shapiro, who was in fact an enemy to her husband, effectively open and Amfest, she came out first, and then Ben Shapiro came out second.

claims.label: Shapiro appeared in person in Charlie's studio after the murder
claims.claim: The host says Ben Shapiro was allowed onto Charlie Kirk's show and appeared in person in his studio, which she calls very odd.
claims.investigative_direction: Find the Charlie Kirk Show episode with Shapiro in the studio and its date.
claims.transcript_snippet: He was also allowed onto Charlie Kirk's uh uh show and appeared in person rather in his studio.

claims.label: Erika has not addressed Josh Hammer's claim Charlie never blinked on Israel
claims.claim: The host says Erika Kirk never came out to say anything about Josh Hammer lying when he said Charlie never blinked on Israel.
claims.investigative_direction: Search Erika Kirk's public statements after Hammer's remarks for any reference to Hammer or to Charlie's Israel position.
claims.transcript_snippet: She never came out and said anything about Josh Hammer lying when he said Charlie effectively that Charlie never blinked on Israel.

claims.label: Erika set up Bari Weiss interviews and pushed Shabbat Shalom
claims.claim: The host says Erika Kirk set up interviews with the likes of Bari Weiss and pushed Charlie's final book, Shabbat Shalom, without ever saying Charlie's donor took money from him.
claims.investigative_direction: Compile Erika's interview schedule and book-promotion appearances after September 2025 and compare against any comment on donor pressure.
claims.transcript_snippet: She was setting up interviews with the likes of Bari Weiss, uh pushing Charlie's final book, Shabbat Shalom, Shabbat Shalom.

claims.label: Erika has never claimed to have worked for a modeling agency
claims.claim: The host says that despite her multi-hyphenated career, Erika Kirk has never made the claim that she worked for a modeling agency.
claims.investigative_direction: Review Erika's published bios and interviews for any mention of employment at Next or another modeling agency.
claims.transcript_snippet: she's actually never made the claim to have worked for a modeling agency.

claims.label: Eyewitnesses recall Erika taking real-estate meetings at Next
claims.claim: The host says eyewitness accounts recall Erika taking meetings at Next Model Management's office that pertained to real estate for models arriving from Eastern Europe.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the eyewitnesses' names, dates and the apartments they associate with Erika; seek corroborating emails or leases.
claims.transcript_snippet: they recall Erika because she was taking meetings at the office and those office were pertaining to real estate.

claims.label: Source describes agencies packing young models into one apartment
claims.claim: The host says her sources confirm it was typical for modeling agencies to find places for girls to stay in New York, and quotes a source saying, "Younger girls, when they first get to New York City, they pack them in like cattle into one apartment."
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-check against reporting and the class action on Next and MC2 model housing for the housing practices described.
claims.transcript_snippet: Younger girls, when they first get to New York City, they pack them in like cattle into one apartment.

claims.label: Erika was the contact for a white building on the Upper East Side
claims.claim: The host says multiple people recall Erika as the contact for a white building on the Upper East Side around 68th Street between 2nd and 3rd Avenues, and that they did not know why.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the building through the eyewitnesses and check Manhattan property, lease and broker-of-record records for Erika's name.
claims.transcript_snippet: Erika Franceway was the contact. Specifically, what they recall is she was the contact for a white building on the Upper East Side, around 68th Street and 2nd and 3rd Avenue.

claims.label: Host says Erika had no real estate license yet during the Next period

claims.investigative_direction: Pin down the dates of the Next-office recollections and compare with the license issue date of October 24, 2018 from the NY Department of State record.
claims.transcript_snippet: the issue that I'm having here is that Erika did not actually have her real estate license yet.

claims.label: Erika told people she was doing real estate deals with her family
claims.claim: The host says Erika specifically told people during that period that she was doing real estate deals with her family, and the host reasons it was more likely the Rothstein family than her Scottsdale family.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask the people who heard this to identify the family and the deals; look for deeds, listings or broker records tied to the Rothsteins.
claims.transcript_snippet: Erika told people specifically during that time that she was doing real estate deals with her family.

claims.label: Erika lived with Nicole Rothstein, who works in real estate
claims.claim: The host says Erika Kirk was living with Nicole Rothstein at that time, and that Nicole Rothstein has a long career in real estate, went to school for it and now runs her own real estate company.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm the shared residence and dates with leases or witnesses, and Nicole Rothstein's licensing and company records.
claims.transcript_snippet: Erika at this time was living with Nicole Rothstein and it is a fact that Nicole Rothstein did work in real estate

claims.label: Alan Rothstein chaired Win Haven Real Estate and Erika calls him uncle
claims.claim: The host says Erika is extremely close to Alan Rothstein, whom she calls uncle, and that he was (and may still be) chairman of Win Haven Real Estates.
claims.investigative_direction: Check New York corporate filings and Win Haven's own materials for Rothstein's chairmanship and dates.

claims.label: Host speculates the Rothsteins could connect to the Rothschilds
claims.claim: The host speculates, while saying she does not know it is true, that if the Rothsteins are related to the Rothstein who fixed the White Sox game, that figure's mother was a Rothschild, which would make them Rothschild relatives.
claims.investigative_direction: Genealogical records of the Rothstein family would confirm or refute any relationship; none has been shown.
claims.transcript_snippet: if they are at all related to Allan uh to the Rothstein that was involved with fixing the White Sox game, that's a Roth child That's a Rothschild family member.

claims.claim: The host says that at this time Erika was trying to be booked onto reality TV shows, including The American Race and dating shows, while pivoting into real estate.
claims.investigative_direction: Collect casting and audition records and dates for The American Race and any dating show to place them against the real estate timeline.
claims.transcript_snippet: trying to be booked onto reality TV shows for fashion or or really anything, The American Race, Dating, whatever she could

claims.investigative_direction: Identify any developer employer or project Erika worked with in New York before her 2018 license.
claims.transcript_snippet: Her experience working on the developer side of the New York City real estate industry is a tremendous asset to her role as an agent.

claims.claim: The bio the host reads says Erika's Everyday Heroes Like You is a 501c3 celebrating its 12th year and long-standing partnership with the United States Marine Corps, expanding into China and Costa Rica while continuing programs in the United States and Constanta, Romania.
claims.investigative_direction: Pull IRS Form 990s and any USMC acknowledgment for Everyday Heroes and verify the China, Costa Rica and Constanta activities.
claims.transcript_snippet: The organization celebrates their 12th year and their long-standing partnership with the United States Marine Corps by expanding into China and Costa Rica

claims.label: Bio lists NCAA basketball, Miss Arizona USA 2012 and a Liberty Juris Master
claims.claim: The bio the host reads lists Erika as a former NCAA women's basketball athlete and Miss Arizona USA 2012, and says she is currently pursuing a Juris Master degree at Liberty University.
claims.investigative_direction: Check pageant and NCAA rosters and request Liberty enrollment confirmation for the Juris Master program.
claims.transcript_snippet: from being a former NCAA women's basketball athlete to Miss Arizona USA 2012

claims.label: Host lists Erika's simultaneous commitments in New York
claims.claim: The host says she struggles to believe Erika could at once do fiduciary real estate deals, help Turning Point, film a reality show, study full-time for a Juris Master and Liberty law degree, complete 77 mandatory hours for a real estate license, run an international charity with the Marines and China work, and run a faith-based clothing company.
claims.investigative_direction: Build a dated timeline of each activity from licensing, enrollment, Everyday Heroes and Turning Point records and test for overlap; verify the 77-hour requirement with the NY Department of State.
claims.transcript_snippet: also in school full-time to get her Juris Masters followed by her law degree at Liberty

claims.claim: The host says Erika now presents her Romania involvement as having just helped send Christmas gifts to children in an orphanage, which the host says would not need the support of the United States Marine Corps.
claims.investigative_direction: Find Erika's own recent statements describing Romanian Angels and compare them with the audition-tape description of opening and sustaining an orphanage.
claims.transcript_snippet: Oh, I was just, you know, helping to send Christmas gifts to kids in need in an orphanage.

claims.claim: The host says the Romanian Angels project's children were living at the Antonio Placement Center in Constanta, Romania, where she says 'our base was'.
claims.investigative_direction: Establish which US base the host means and whether Romanian Angels' beneficiaries were housed at the center through Romanian child-protection or NGO records.
claims.transcript_snippet: the Romanian Angels so to speak were living at Antonio's Placement Center in Constanta, Romania where our base was.

claims.investigative_direction: Identify which fact-checks the writer means and what they actually examined.
claims.transcript_snippet: While independent fact-checkers have found no evidence linking Ms. Kirk's work to illicit activities, I believe the history of the Antonio Placement Center warrants further investigation.

claims.investigative_direction: Collect each of Erika's and Bowyer's accounts of the first meeting and compare them.
claims.transcript_snippet: Tyler Bowyer, Erika's friend, her dear friend, who introduced her to her husband, but for the life of her, she cannot remember how they met.

claims.label: Host links Bowyer's 2010 Romania trip to the base setup and Dennis Frantzve
claims.claim: The host says she does not think it is just an ironic coincidence that Tyler Bowyer went to Romania in 2010 right when the military base was set up and when Dennis Frantzve (transcribed 'Dennis Brantsbay') was there.
claims.investigative_direction: Establish the dates of the base setup, Frantzve's Romania posting and Bowyer's trip, which another node dates to 2011.
